messages:
Eli K: Quick sync — I sketched a launch-lanes proposal for private deployments (VPC + on‑prem). Focus is minimal risk upgrades and clear network preflight. Will paste checklist here.

Priya S: Love it. Please call out customer-managed IP preservation and peering rollback options — ACME flagged sticky IPs as non-negotiable.

Tom R: Agreed on sticky IP. Ops also wants an explicit rollback window per lane. I suggest: Canary (10%) -> Regional (50%) -> Full (100%) with a 30m hold at each stage.

Eli K: Proposed success gates for each stage: auth error rate <=0.1% AND tail latency regression <5%. If either fails, auto-stage rollback.

Ana L: Packaging note: offline/onprem customers need an installer bundle that can bake in TLS certs and connector config. We should produce a separate "airgap" artifact.

Priya S: For upgrade compatibility, we should support +2 minor versions (shim) so field customers aren't forced to jump. If not possible, add explicit migration steps in runbook.

Tom R: Networking prechecks list (ops): CIDR overlap, route table tags present, allowed egress to telemetry endpoints, BGP ASN if peering. We should provide a preflight script customers can run.

Eli K: I'll draft a preflight script and include it in the installer. Example quick command: `curl -fsS https://installer.redwood/preflight.sh | bash -s -- --cidr-check --telemetry-check`

sre-bot: Note: Canary rollout will trigger job `net-gate` that validates NewRelic metrics and token-exchange error rates. Pipeline will mark a failure if gates are tripped.

Ana L: Field ask: add an opt-in flag for "managed-nat" vs "bring-your-own-nat" in the installer. That impacts docs and support commitments.

Priya S: Updated launch criteria checklist: docs + preflight tool + rollback playbook + support runbook + 2 successful beta customer upgrades.

Tom R: Who owns the rollback playbook? Eng-Platform or SRE?

Eli K: Eng-Platform authors, SRE reviews + oncall drills. I'll own organizing a 30m runbook review with @Tom R and @Priya S tomorrow.

Ana L: Also loop Legal for cross-account VPC peering terms and Security for KMS/HSM guidance on the airgap artifact.

Eli K: Thanks — I'll push the draft checklist to the repo and link it here once it's up. :thumbsup:
